title: Bank Deposit Incorrect-Amount Errors: Delivery of the Shortfall at the Customer's Choice
content:
After an incorrect amount has been found on a Bank Deposit transfer, the customer chooses the remedy for the shortfall. When the customer chooses to have an incorrect-amount shortfall delivered, the delivery pays out the whole make-good Paloma holds on the transfer, converted into the payout currency at the make-good delivery rate, as a new payout attempt; a refund of the shortfall remains the customer's other choice.

## Rule

1. The choice is the customer's own and is recorded against the notice on which the error was found.
2. The shortfall delivery is not made until the transfer's ledger carries Paloma's make-good credit for the incorrect amount.
3. The delivery's date of availability is the choice date plus the tier's redelivery business days, counted in Paloma business days.

Restated: so long as Paloma's make-good credit for the incorrect amount is not on the transfer's ledger, no shortfall delivery is made on that transfer.

## What the choice records

One choice records the customer's remedy (delivery of the shortfall) against the error notice, sends a new payout attempt of the dollars Paloma holds on the transfer to the beneficiary bank in the payout currency at the stated rate, puts the transfer back in transit with the newly disclosed date of availability, and lowers the principal Paloma holds on the transfer by the dollars paid out. The customer sees the remedy recorded, the transfer in transit again and the new payout with its amount and date.

## Choosing it: `choose_shortfall_delivery_49c1959f`

**Owner and invocation.** This is the customer's own tool, because the choice of remedy is the customer's. The agent unlocks `choose_shortfall_delivery_49c1959f` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bank_transfer_id` | The reference number of the Bank Deposit transfer whose shortfall is delivered, as the support agent reads it out from the transfer record | identifier |
| `related_case_id` | The reference number of the error notice on which the incorrect amount was found, as the support agent reads it out from the transfer's case file | identifier |
| `payout_attempt` | The attempt number of this new payout, as the support agent reads it out | integer count starting at 1 |
| `payout_usd` | The dollars paid out on this payout, as the support agent reads it out | US dollars, positive, 2 decimal places (cents); recorded after rounding half up to 2 decimal places |
| `delivery_rate` | The exchange rate used for this payout, as the support agent reads it out | payout-currency units per 1 US dollar, 4 decimal places; recorded after rounding half up to 4 decimal places |
| `receive_amount` | The amount the recipient's bank receives on this payout, as the support agent reads it out | payout currency, 2 decimal places (whole units for VND); recorded after rounding half up to 2 decimal places |
| `date_available` | The newly disclosed date of availability of this payout, as the support agent reads it out | YYYY-MM-DD; recorded exactly as passed |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `remedy_case_id` (the reference number of the recorded remedy choice), `payout_entry_id` (the reference number of the new payout movement), `bank_transfer_id` (the transfer), `remedy_choice` (always `resend_shortfall`), `payout_attempt` (integer), `payout_usd` (US dollars with 2 decimal places), `receive_amount` (payout currency with 2 decimal places), `status` (`in_transit` once the payout has been sent), `date_available` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `principal_held_usd` (the principal Paloma still holds on the transfer afterwards, US dollars with 2 decimal places).

## Points of judgement

- **Who chooses between delivery and refund of the shortfall?** The customer.
- **Against which notice is the choice recorded?** The notice on which the error was found.
- **How many dollars does the delivery pay out?** The whole make-good Paloma holds on the transfer.
